propositions: The mutation gate workflow runs from main but executes against the checked-out patchset tree, causing hard failure when the patchset predates the commit that introduced scripts/mutation_gate.py
When scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from the checked-out tree, the gate fails with exit code 2 and produces Verified -1, incorrectly flagging changes based on older commits as problematic

Sibling gates (gen_env_registry.py, check_comment_hygiene.py) already implement file-existence guards that skip cleanly with explanatory messages instead of failing, but the mutation gate lacks this guard
The mutation gate must skip with exit 0 and a message explaining the change predates the gate, while still executing normally for changes at or after the script was introduced
